table.name: course
table.purpose: Catalog of courses offered, each with a start date; referenced by course_arrange to assign teachers and grades.

Course.name: Course name
Course.description: Name of the course/subject (e.g. Math, History, Bible, French).

Course_ID.name: Course ID
Course_ID.description: Primary key identifying each course; referenced by course_arrange.Course_ID.

Staring_Date.name: Starting date
Staring_Date.description: Date the course begins, stored as text in 'D Month' format (e.g. '6 May'); year not recorded. Column name is a misspelling of 'Starting_Date'.

table.name: course_arrange
table.purpose: Junction/assignment table linking courses, teachers and grades: each row records that a teacher teaches a course to a particular grade.

Course_ID.name: Course ID
Course_ID.description: Foreign key to course.Course_ID identifying the course being taught.

Grade.name: Grade level
Grade.description: Grade/class level (school year) to which the course is taught; values 1-7.

Teacher_ID.name: Teacher ID
Teacher_ID.description: Foreign key to teacher.Teacher_ID identifying the teacher assigned to the course.

table.name: teacher
table.purpose: Roster of teachers with their age and hometown; referenced by course_arrange for teaching assignments.

Age.name: Age
Age.description: Teacher's age in years (26-45), stored as text despite being numeric.

Hometown.name: Hometown
Hometown.description: Teacher's hometown, given as an administrative area name (e.g. Blackrod Urban District, Bolton County Borough).

Teacher_ID.name: Teacher ID
Teacher_ID.description: Primary key identifying each teacher; referenced by course_arrange.Teacher_ID.
